title: Welcome to Blind Whisper
subtitle: Two quick taps and Blind Whisper works like a real app — so you never miss a whisp.

install.title: Get the app
install.body: Open Blind Whisper from your home screen, full screen, like any other app.
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari's toolbar
install.iosStep2: Choose “Add to Home Screen”, then Add
install.inAppBrowser: You're in another app's browser, which can't install apps. Open this page in Safari or Chrome to install.
install.unavailable: This browser can't install apps — you can still use Blind Whisper right here, or open it in Chrome, Edge or Safari later.
install.doneBody: Blind Whisper is on your home screen.

notify.title: Turn on alerts
notify.body: Know the moment someone whispers to you, replies, or answers your debate. Alerts never show who sent anything.
notify.afterInstall: On iPhone, alerts work once Blind Whisper is on your Home Screen — open it from there and turn them on in Settings.
notify.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. You can allow them in your browser settings anytime.
notify.unsupported: This browser doesn't support alerts. You'll still see everything in the app.
notify.doneBody: We'll let you know when something arrives.
